capstone.title: Breach of a Small Company
capstone.desc: Simulated engagement: scope the test, recon and exploit a web app, then switch to SOC and triage the logs, contain it, and report with CVSS and a NIST CSF mapping.

cert_note: Guide only: covers CompTIA Security+ concept areas and builds a base for eJPT and BTL1, but it is not an official prep course.

can_do: Classify controls and scenarios by CIA triad property
Map an attack to kill chain stages and ATT&CK tactics
Compare NIST CSF, ISO 27001 and CIS Controls by purpose

lessons.title: CIA triad and its failure modes
lessons.goal: Explain confidentiality, integrity and availability and give an attack and a control for each.

lessons.title: AAA and non-repudiation
lessons.goal: Distinguish authentication, authorization, accounting and show how signatures and logs give non-repudiation.

lessons.title: Defense in depth and least privilege
lessons.goal: Layer preventive, detective and corrective controls and apply least privilege and separation of duties.

lessons.title: Zero trust fundamentals
lessons.goal: Describe never trust, always verify, microsegmentation and policy decision points per NIST SP 800-207.

lessons.title: Kill chain and MITRE ATT&CK
lessons.goal: Map intrusion activity to the seven Lockheed Martin kill chain stages and ATT&CK tactics and techniques.

lessons.title: NIST CSF, ISO 27001 and CIS Controls
lessons.goal: Compare the CSF functions, ISO 27001 ISMS and Annex A, and CIS Controls IG1-IG3 safeguards.

labs.title: Tag scenarios by CIA property
labs.task: Read 8 incident snippets and tag which CIA property each one violated, then choose the matching control.

labs.title: Map an intrusion to ATT&CK
labs.task: Place observed events onto kill chain stages and attach ATT&CK technique IDs such as T1566 and T1059.

labs.title: Match controls to NIST CSF functions
labs.task: Sort 12 controls into Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover and flag the gaps in a sample program.

labs.title: Review an access log for AAA gaps
labs.task: Find unauthenticated requests, over-privileged accounts and missing accounting entries in a sample audit log.

checkpoint.focus: CIA classification, AAA terms, kill chain and ATT&CK mapping, CSF functions vs ISO 27001 vs CIS

can_do: Differentiate threat actors by motive, capability and TTPs
Identify malware families from behavior and indicators
Explain how real incidents unfolded and which control would have stopped them

lessons.title: Threat actors and motives
lessons.goal: Compare nation-state, criminal, hacktivist, insider and script-kiddie actors by resources and motivation.

lessons.title: Attack surface and common attack types
lessons.goal: Describe brute force, credential stuffing, password spraying, supply chain and zero-day attack types.

lessons.title: Viruses, worms and trojans
lessons.goal: Explain how viruses, worms and trojans propagate and how each is detected.

lessons.title: Ransomware and extortion
lessons.goal: Describe the ransomware chain from initial access to encryption, double extortion and RaaS.

lessons.title: Spyware, RATs, botnets and C2
lessons.goal: Explain keyloggers, RATs, botnet C2 channels and beaconing indicators.

lessons.title: Incident case studies
lessons.goal: Analyze WannaCry, NotPetya, SolarWinds, Colonial Pipeline and Equifax for root cause and missed controls.

labs.title: Classify malware samples
labs.task: Review 6 behavior reports (file changes, network calls, persistence) and label the malware family.

labs.title: Spot C2 beaconing in packets
labs.task: Find periodic HTTP or DNS callbacks in a capture and identify the infected host and C2 domain.

labs.title: Read a ransomware process tree
labs.task: Trace Sysmon events from a phishing attachment to shadow copy deletion and encryption.

labs.title: Build the case study timeline
labs.task: Order the SolarWinds or Equifax events on a timeline and mark where a control would break the chain.

checkpoint.focus: Actor motives, malware family traits, attack types, root causes in case studies

can_do: Recognize phishing, smishing and vishing indicators
Analyze a suspicious email header and URL
Choose technical and human controls against social engineering

lessons.title: Social engineering principles
lessons.goal: Explain authority, urgency, scarcity and trust as levers and the pretexting attack cycle.

lessons.title: Phishing, spear phishing and whaling
lessons.goal: Identify mass, targeted and executive phishing and the credential harvesting and payload variants.

lessons.title: Smishing, vishing and QR phishing
lessons.goal: Recognize SMS, voice and QR lure patterns, caller ID spoofing and MFA fatigue prompts.

lessons.title: Business email compromise
lessons.goal: Describe BEC variants such as invoice fraud and CEO fraud and the verification steps that stop them.

lessons.title: Spotting fakes and defending
lessons.goal: Inspect headers (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), lookalike domains, link hover and apply reporting and awareness controls.

labs.title: Triage a phishing inbox
labs.task: Sort 10 emails into legitimate, phishing and BEC and name the strongest indicator in each.

labs.title: Read email headers
labs.task: Check Received chain, Return-Path and SPF, DKIM, DMARC results to prove a sender is spoofed.

labs.title: Dissect a malicious URL
labs.task: Decode a shortened and obfuscated link, spot the lookalike domain and the redirect chain in a sandbox.

labs.title: Handle a vishing call
labs.task: Respond to a caller requesting a password reset and choose verification steps that deny the attacker.

checkpoint.focus: Phishing variants, header analysis, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, BEC verification controls

can_do: Choose between encoding, encryption and hashing
Explain how keys, certificates and TLS protect a connection
Store passwords safely with salted slow hashes

lessons.title: Encoding vs encryption vs hashing
lessons.goal: Distinguish Base64 encoding, reversible encryption and one-way hashing with a use case for each.

lessons.title: Symmetric encryption
lessons.goal: Explain AES, block modes (ECB, CBC, GCM), IVs and why key distribution is the hard part.

lessons.title: Asymmetric encryption and key exchange
lessons.goal: Describe RSA, ECC and Diffie-Hellman and how public and private keys solve key exchange.

lessons.title: Hashing, HMAC and salting
lessons.goal: Compare MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, explain collisions, HMAC and why salts defeat rainbow tables.

lessons.title: Digital signatures
lessons.goal: Explain how signing with a private key gives integrity, authenticity and non-repudiation.

lessons.title: Certificates and PKI
lessons.goal: Describe X.509 fields, CA chains, root stores, CSR, revocation (CRL, OCSP) and expiry.

lessons.title: The TLS 1.2 and 1.3 handshake
lessons.goal: Walk through ClientHello, key exchange, certificate validation, forward secrecy and cipher suites.

lessons.title: Password storage and cracking
lessons.goal: Compare bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2 and PBKDF2, and explain dictionary, brute force and pepper.

labs.title: Decode, decrypt and hash
labs.task: Use base64, openssl enc and sha256sum on sample data and state which operation is reversible.

labs.title: Spot weak crypto choices
labs.task: Fix a TLS config by removing SSLv3, RC4 and CBC suites and enabling TLS 1.3 with strong ciphers.

labs.title: Verify a signed file
labs.task: Check a SHA-256 checksum and an openssl signature and detect a tampered download.

labs.title: Inspect a certificate chain
labs.task: Open sample X.509 certs, find issuer, SAN and expiry, and spot the broken chain or hostname mismatch.

labs.title: Read a TLS handshake
labs.task: Identify ClientHello, ServerHello, selected cipher and certificate frames in a capture.

labs.title: Crack weak password hashes
labs.task: Run a wordlist against unsalted MD5 hashes in a sandbox, then show bcrypt resisting the same attack.

checkpoint.focus: Encoding vs encryption vs hashing, symmetric vs asymmetric, PKI, TLS handshake, password storage

can_do: Compare authentication factors and MFA methods
Trace SAML and OAuth/OIDC flows and their tokens
Design RBAC and ABAC rules and secure sessions

lessons.title: Passwords and password managers
lessons.goal: Apply NIST SP 800-63B guidance on length, breach checks and the role of managers and passkeys.

lessons.title: MFA and biometrics
lessons.goal: Compare TOTP, push, FIDO2/WebAuthn and biometrics, and explain MFA fatigue and SIM swap risks.

lessons.title: Single sign-on and Kerberos basics
lessons.goal: Explain SSO, identity providers and the Kerberos ticket-granting flow at concept level.

lessons.title: SAML, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect
lessons.goal: Distinguish SAML assertions, OAuth access tokens and OIDC ID tokens and the authorization code flow.

lessons.title: RBAC, ABAC and access models
lessons.goal: Compare DAC, MAC, RBAC and ABAC and apply least privilege and periodic access reviews.

lessons.title: Session management and JWTs
lessons.goal: Secure session IDs, cookies, timeouts and JWT signature, expiry and audience validation.

labs.title: Choose MFA for scenarios
labs.task: Select the right factor for 6 user groups and justify against phishing resistance and usability.

labs.title: Decode a JWT and find flaws
labs.task: Inspect a captured JWT, spot alg none or a missing exp claim and replay it in the sandbox.

labs.title: Trace an OAuth authorization code flow
labs.task: Arrange redirects, code and token exchange steps and mark where state and PKCE protect the flow.

labs.title: Build RBAC roles
labs.task: Edit a role matrix to enforce least privilege and remove a separation of duties conflict.

checkpoint.focus: Factors and MFA, SAML vs OAuth vs OIDC, RBAC vs ABAC, session and token security

can_do: Configure firewall rules and segment a network
Distinguish IDS, IPS, proxy and VPN roles
Recognize and mitigate MITM, ARP spoofing and DoS

lessons.title: Firewalls and ACLs
lessons.goal: Write stateless and stateful rules, apply default deny and explain NGFW and WAF differences.

lessons.title: IDS, IPS and network monitoring
lessons.goal: Compare signature and anomaly detection, Snort and Suricata rules and NIDS vs HIDS placement.

lessons.title: Proxies, VPNs and tunneling
lessons.goal: Explain forward and reverse proxies, IPsec and WireGuard VPNs, split tunneling and TLS inspection.

lessons.title: Segmentation, VLANs and the DMZ
lessons.goal: Design zones, VLANs and a DMZ so that a compromised host cannot reach internal systems.

lessons.title: Wi-Fi security
lessons.goal: Compare WEP, WPA2, WPA3, PSK and 802.1X, and describe evil twin and deauthentication attacks.

lessons.title: MITM, ARP spoofing and DNS attacks
lessons.goal: Explain ARP cache poisoning, DNS spoofing, SSL stripping and defenses such as DAI and HSTS.

lessons.title: DoS, DDoS and secure protocols
lessons.goal: Explain SYN floods and amplification, their mitigations, and swap Telnet, FTP, HTTP for SSH, SFTP, HTTPS.

labs.title: Write firewall rules
labs.task: Build an iptables or ACL ruleset that allows web traffic, blocks lateral movement and logs drops.

labs.title: Design a DMZ network
labs.task: Place web, DB and admin hosts in zones and draw the allowed flows between them.

labs.title: Detect ARP spoofing
labs.task: Find duplicate MAC to IP mappings and gratuitous ARP replies in a capture and name the attacker.

labs.title: Tune a Suricata alert
labs.task: Review IDS alerts, separate false positives and write a rule to catch a port scan.

labs.title: Triage a SYN flood
labs.task: Identify the flood from connection logs, find top sources and select the right mitigation.

checkpoint.focus: Firewall rule logic, IDS vs IPS, segmentation, Wi-Fi standards, MITM and DoS defenses, secure protocols

can_do: Identify OWASP Top 10 flaws in requests and code
Exploit and fix SQL injection, XSS, IDOR and CSRF in a sandbox
Apply secure headers, cookie flags and input handling

lessons.title: HTTP basics and the OWASP Top 10
lessons.goal: Review request, response, methods and status codes and name the categories of the OWASP Top 10.

lessons.title: Injection: SQLi and command injection
lessons.goal: Explain how unsanitized input alters queries and fix with parameterized statements and validation.

lessons.title: Cross-site scripting
lessons.goal: Distinguish reflected, stored and DOM XSS and apply output encoding and Content Security Policy.

lessons.title: Broken authentication and session flaws
lessons.goal: Identify weak login, session fixation and credential stuffing weaknesses and their fixes.

lessons.title: Broken access control and IDOR
lessons.goal: Detect IDOR and missing function-level checks and enforce server-side authorization.

lessons.title: CSRF and SSRF
lessons.goal: Explain forged state-changing requests and server-side request forgery, with tokens and SameSite as defenses.

lessons.title: Misconfiguration and vulnerable components
lessons.goal: Find default credentials, verbose errors, directory listing and outdated libraries (SCA, SBOM).

lessons.title: Secure headers, cookies and testing
lessons.goal: Set HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options and Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookie flags and use Burp or ZAP.

labs.title: Intercept and modify a request
labs.task: Capture a login request in a proxy, change a parameter and observe the server response.

labs.title: Exploit SQL injection safely
labs.task: Use a quote and UNION payload against a sandbox app to extract a user table, then note the cause.

labs.title: Fix an injectable query
labs.task: Replace string concatenation with a parameterized query and verify the payload no longer works.

labs.title: Find stored XSS
labs.task: Submit a payload to a sandbox comment box, confirm execution and apply output encoding.

labs.title: Enumerate IDOR
labs.task: Change an order ID in a sandbox API call to read another user's data, then add an ownership check.

labs.title: Harden headers and cookies
labs.task: Add CSP, HSTS and cookie flags to a server config and re-scan for missing headers.

checkpoint.focus: OWASP categories, SQLi and XSS mechanics and fixes, IDOR, CSRF, headers and cookie flags

can_do: Apply a hardening baseline to a system
Explain how AV, EDR and allowlisting detect and block threats
Design a backup and encryption plan

lessons.title: System hardening basics
lessons.goal: Apply CIS Benchmarks: remove unused services, enforce least privilege, secure defaults and baseline configs.

lessons.title: Patch management
lessons.goal: Describe the patch cycle, test rings, emergency patches and risks of unsupported software.

lessons.title: Antivirus, EDR and application allowlisting
lessons.goal: Compare signature, heuristic and behavior detection, EDR telemetry and AppLocker-style allowlists.

lessons.title: Disk encryption and mobile device security
lessons.goal: Explain BitLocker, FileVault, LUKS, TPM, MDM, jailbreaking and mobile app permissions.

lessons.title: Backups and recovery
lessons.goal: Apply the 3-2-1 rule, immutable and offline backups, RPO, RTO and restore testing against ransomware.

labs.title: Harden a Linux server
labs.task: Run commands to disable unused services, fix file permissions and set SSH to key-only login.

labs.title: Audit a Windows baseline
labs.task: Compare a policy export to a CIS baseline and correct failing settings such as SMBv1 and password length.

labs.title: Triage an EDR detection
labs.task: Review an EDR alert, inspect the process tree and decide to isolate the host or close as benign.

labs.title: Plan backups for ransomware
labs.task: Choose backup types, locations and test schedule that meet given RPO and RTO after a ransomware event.

checkpoint.focus: Hardening steps, patching, AV vs EDR, allowlisting, disk encryption, 3-2-1 backups

can_do: Distinguish vulnerability, exploit and risk
Read CVE, CWE and CVSS data and prioritize findings
Run a scan-to-remediation cycle and know bug bounty basics

lessons.title: Vulnerability, threat, exploit and risk
lessons.goal: Define each term and relate them with risk = likelihood x impact.

lessons.title: CVE, CWE, NVD and exploit databases
lessons.goal: Look up CVE IDs, CWE weakness classes, NVD records and Exploit-DB or CISA KEV entries.

lessons.title: CVSS scoring
lessons.goal: Read a CVSS v3.1 vector (AV, AC, PR, UI, S, C, I, A) and compute the severity band.

lessons.title: Scanning and the patching process
lessons.goal: Explain authenticated vs unauthenticated scans with Nessus or OpenVAS, false positives and remediation SLAs.

lessons.title: Prioritization and bug bounty overview
lessons.goal: Prioritize with CVSS, KEV, EPSS and asset value, and describe disclosure and bug bounty programs.

labs.title: Score a CVSS vector
labs.task: Set base metrics for 4 vulnerabilities and compare the resulting scores and severity.

labs.title: Triage scanner output
labs.task: Review a scan report, remove false positives and group findings by host and fix.

labs.title: Search CVE records
labs.task: Use searchsploit and a CVE lookup on a sandbox service banner to find known vulnerabilities.

labs.title: Rank the remediation queue
labs.task: Order 8 findings using CVSS, KEV status and asset criticality and assign SLAs.

checkpoint.focus: CVE vs CWE vs CVSS, vector reading, scanner types, prioritization logic, patch process

can_do: Search and correlate logs in a SIEM
Triage alerts and escalate correctly
Follow incident response phases and preserve evidence

lessons.title: Logging and monitoring fundamentals
lessons.goal: Identify key log sources (Windows Event IDs, syslog, auth, proxy, DNS) and time sync and retention needs.

lessons.title: SIEM basics
lessons.goal: Explain log ingestion, normalization, correlation rules and search queries in Splunk or Elastic.

lessons.title: SOC roles and alert triage
lessons.goal: Describe Tier 1-3 roles and triage steps: validate, scope, enrich and classify true or false positives.

lessons.title: Threat intelligence intro
lessons.goal: Use IOCs, TTPs, STIX/TAXII, MISP and the Pyramid of Pain to enrich alerts.

lessons.title: Incident response lifecycle
lessons.goal: Apply NIST SP 800-61 phases: preparation, detection, containment, eradication, recovery, lessons learned.

lessons.title: Digital forensics fundamentals
lessons.goal: Explain order of volatility, disk and memory images, hashing evidence and chain of custody.

lessons.title: Detection use cases and playbooks
lessons.goal: Write a brute force detection rule and a runbook with escalation and communication steps.

labs.title: Hunt failed logins in a SIEM
labs.task: Query auth logs for Event ID 4625 spikes and identify the source IP and targeted accounts.

labs.title: Triage a phishing alert
labs.task: Enrich a sender, URL and attachment hash with threat intel and decide the verdict.

labs.title: Analyze a Linux auth.log
labs.task: Find the SSH brute force, successful login and subsequent sudo activity.

labs.title: Contain a compromised host
labs.task: Choose containment, eradication and recovery actions in order for a simulated infection.

labs.title: Preserve evidence
labs.task: Hash disk image files, record chain of custody and sort evidence by order of volatility.

checkpoint.focus: Log sources, SIEM queries, triage decisions, IOC use, IR phases, evidence handling

can_do: Describe pentest phases and rules of engagement
Perform recon, scanning and enumeration in a sandbox
Report findings with evidence and remediation

lessons.title: Ethical hacking, scope and rules of engagement
lessons.goal: Explain authorization, scope, SOW, legal limits (CFAA) and pentest types (black, grey, white box).

lessons.title: Pentest methodology
lessons.goal: Walk through PTES phases: planning, recon, scanning, exploitation, post-exploitation, reporting.

lessons.title: Reconnaissance and OSINT
lessons.goal: Use whois, DNS, Google dorks, Shodan and theHarvester for passive and active recon.

lessons.title: Scanning and enumeration
lessons.goal: Use Nmap scan types, service and version detection, NSE and SMB or web enumeration.

lessons.title: Exploitation overview
lessons.goal: Explain exploit selection, Metasploit modules, payload types and web exploitation in lab scope.

lessons.title: Post-exploitation
lessons.goal: Describe privilege escalation, credential access, lateral movement and persistence, and cleanup.

lessons.title: Reporting and remediation advice
lessons.goal: Write an executive summary, findings with CVSS, reproduction steps and prioritized fixes.

labs.title: Check scope before testing
labs.task: Read a rules-of-engagement document and decide which of 8 actions are in or out of scope.

labs.title: Passive recon on a target
labs.task: Gather subdomains, emails and tech stack from sandbox OSINT sources without touching the target.

labs.title: Scan with Nmap
labs.task: Run host discovery, a service scan and NSE scripts, then interpret open ports and versions.

labs.title: Exploit a vulnerable service
labs.task: Pick a matching Metasploit module in the sandbox, set options and obtain a shell.

labs.title: Escalate privileges
labs.task: Enumerate SUID files and sudo rights on a sandbox host and gain root.

checkpoint.focus: Scope and legality, PTES phases, Nmap output, exploit concepts, post-exploitation, report content

can_do: Identify PII and classify data by sensitivity
Summarize GDPR and CCPA rights and obligations
Apply DLP, retention and compliance framework basics

lessons.title: PII, data classification and handling
lessons.goal: Classify data as public, internal, confidential or restricted and identify PII, PHI and cardholder data.

lessons.title: GDPR and CCPA basics
lessons.goal: Explain lawful basis, data subject rights, DPO, breach notification in 72 hours and CCPA opt-out rights.

lessons.title: DLP, retention and disposal
lessons.goal: Describe DLP detection and blocking, retention schedules, anonymization, pseudonymization and secure disposal.

lessons.title: Compliance frameworks overview
lessons.goal: Compare PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOX, SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and explain audits, evidence and risk registers.

labs.title: Classify a data set
labs.task: Label sample files and database fields by sensitivity and pick the required handling for each.

labs.title: Handle a data subject request
labs.task: Decide the steps and deadlines for an access or deletion request under GDPR.

labs.title: Tune a DLP policy
labs.task: Write rules that block SSN and card numbers in outbound email while limiting false positives.

checkpoint.focus: PII types, classification levels, GDPR rights and deadlines, DLP, framework purposes

can_do: Apply the shared responsibility model by service type
Find IAM and storage misconfigurations
Describe container isolation and basic hardening

lessons.title: Cloud service and deployment models
lessons.goal: Compare IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and public, private, hybrid cloud, and shared responsibility per model.

lessons.title: Cloud IAM
lessons.goal: Write least-privilege policies, understand roles vs users, MFA on root, and key and access key hygiene.

lessons.title: Common cloud misconfigurations
lessons.goal: Identify open security groups, public snapshots, exposed secrets and missing logging (CloudTrail).

lessons.title: Storage exposure and data protection
lessons.goal: Check S3 and blob ACLs, public access blocks, encryption at rest, KMS and presigned URLs.

lessons.title: Containers 101
lessons.goal: Explain images, namespaces, cgroups, Docker vs VMs, registry risks, running as root and secrets in images.

labs.title: Fix an over-permissive IAM policy
labs.task: Replace wildcard Action and Resource entries in a JSON policy with least-privilege permissions.

labs.title: Audit a cloud storage bucket
labs.task: Find publicly readable objects and exposed credentials and apply a public access block.

labs.title: Review cloud audit logs
labs.task: Trace an access key abuse using CloudTrail events and identify the creating role and source IP.

labs.title: Harden a Dockerfile
labs.task: Remove root user, pin the base image, drop embedded secrets and verify the fixed file.

checkpoint.focus: Shared responsibility, IAM least privilege, storage exposure, misconfigs, container basics

can_do: Match certifications to career goals
Plan a portfolio that shows practical skills
Choose a specialization and a practice routine

lessons.title: Certification map
lessons.goal: Compare Security+, Network+, CySA+, eJPT, BTL1, CEH, SSCP and CISSP by level, focus and prerequisites.

lessons.title: Portfolio, labs and CTFs
lessons.goal: Build a portfolio with write-ups, a home lab and CTF practice on platforms like picoCTF and HackTheBox.

lessons.title: Choosing a specialization
lessons.goal: Compare SOC, pentest, GRC, cloud, DFIR, AppSec and engineering roles by daily work and skills.

labs.title: Build a certification roadmap
labs.task: Pick a role goal and order 4 certifications with prerequisites and reasons.

labs.title: Match skills to a role
labs.task: Answer a career advisor's questions and get matched to a specialization with next steps.

checkpoint.focus: Certification levels and focus, portfolio contents, role comparison

can_do: Recall core concepts across all Security Core modules
Solve mixed scenario questions under time
Identify weak areas to revisit

lessons.title: Mixed review across modules
lessons.goal: Retrieve and connect principles, cryptography, web, network and defense concepts through mixed questions.

lessons.title: Final exam strategy and review
lessons.goal: Apply scenario-question technique, eliminate distractors and review missed topics before the final exam.

labs.title: Mixed incident scenario
labs.task: Work a multi-domain case from phishing to data exposure and choose the right control at each step.

labs.title: Weak-area log review
labs.task: Answer review tasks on alerts and logs from earlier modules and track which domains you missed.

checkpoint.focus: Mixed questions from all 14 modules with emphasis on scenario judgment
